resources.string: Headset for tile and automatic mode

Automatic mode watches recording status, never audio. It may react to any microphone app, including dictation or camera recording. Choose one headset for it. Routing stops 5 seconds after recording ends, or at the session limit. A timed-out recording must stop before another automatic session starts.

Automatic mode keeps a background notification while enabled. Stop or the tile disables it; it does not restart after reboot.

Duration and headset changes apply to the next session. Reapply keeps the original deadline; Add 5 minutes extends it.

Connect your headset, then tap its route button or use the Headset mic Quick Settings tile. The default session stops after 5 minutes. Settings lets you choose another duration and your preferred headset. Long press the tile for Settings.

Optional automatic mode reacts to microphone recording activity. It needs a background notification and is experimental: Android or the recording app can still override routing.

While routing, silent playback keeps the headset call path active. This never records audio, but uses battery and can reduce media quality. The notification offers Stop, Add 5 minutes and Reapply headset.
Grant Nearby devices permission to select a headset.
No SCO/HFP or BLE headset communication device is available. Connect a headset that supports calls, then refresh.
